notes: Each case builds its own scratch root $ROOT. The audited repository is $ROOT/repo on branch main. A worktree named N is at $ROOT/repo/.claude/worktrees/N.

Each `at` is hours relative to the moment the step runs, negative for the past, and -240 when it is absent. A git step runs with GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE set to it, so its commits and reflog entries carry it. A written file gets it as atime and mtime.
After init the runner writes `config` below, merged with each `config` step, to $ROOT/repo/.agents/harness.toml. The file stays untracked.

`ah branch-audit` runs with `--json --projects-root $ROOT/claude-projects`, then the args of the case, from `cwd` (a worktree name, else the main checkout). NO_COLOR is 1, and the global and system git config are /dev/null. The `env` of a case adds variables, $ROOT replaced.

`shell_in` names a worktree: bash starts there and runs the command from `cwd` in a subshell, so a parent process works inside that worktree. `text: true` runs without `--json`, and `expect.stdout` lists strings that the standard output holds.

`before_apply` is a shell command that the case runner gives `branches.main` as its `before_apply` function. It runs from the main checkout after the audit and before `--apply` runs anything, and stands in for a peer that writes while the plan waits.

`expect` holds `exit` (0 when absent), and per report key a value or a map of rows by name (worktrees, strays), ref (branches, remotes) or id (plan). A row given as null must be absent. A row matches in part: a null field is absent or null, an object whose keys start with $ is a matcher ($gte, $lte, $type), and any other value compares equal after $ROOT is replaced.

`names` lists the exact set of row names per section. `order` lists names that appear in that order. `after` states what exists once the run ends: `paths` under $ROOT, `refs` as <folder under $ROOT>:<full ref>, and `processes_alive` when each process of the setup still runs.
A transcript folder name is the real path of the worktree with each UTF-16 code unit outside A-Z, a-z and 0-9 replaced by '-'.
`mb` is bytes / 1048576, rounded half up to one decimal, over every file under the folder without following a symlink. `idle_hours` and `session_idle_hours` round the same way.

ops.init: {files?, at?}: git init -b main at $ROOT/repo, commit `files` (default {"src/a.txt": "base\n"}) on main as "base", then write the config file
ops.branch: {name, from?, at?}: git branch <name> <from>, `from` defaulting to main
ops.commit: {branch, files?, many?, message?, at?}: in the checkout holding `branch` (else the main checkout after checking it out, back on main after), write each file, remove each whose value is null, stage exactly those paths in one git add and commit. `many` {prefix, count, text} adds `count` files named `prefix` plus the index zero-padded to the width of count-1, each holding `text`
ops.land: {branch, how, at?}: on main in the main checkout. merge: git merge --no-ff --no-edit <branch>. rebase: git cherry-pick <merge-base>..<branch>. cherry-pick: git cherry-pick <branch>. The branch ref never moves
ops.worktree: {name, branch? | new_branch + from? | detach, at?}: git worktree add $ROOT/repo/.claude/worktrees/<name> with <branch>, with -b <new_branch> <from> (from defaulting to main), or with --detach <detach>
ops.detach: {worktree, rev?, at?}: git checkout --detach <rev> inside the worktree, `rev` defaulting to HEAD
ops.write: {path, text, repeat?, in?, mode?, at?}: write `text` repeated `repeat` times (default 1) to `path` inside the checkout `in` (a worktree name, the main checkout when absent), creating folders, then chmod to octal `mode` when given
ops.folder: {name, files, at?}: create $ROOT/repo/.claude/worktrees/<name>/ holding `files`, a folder git does not know
ops.remove_folder: {worktree}: delete the worktree's folder from disk and leave git's entry, so git lists it prunable
ops.lock: {worktree, owner}: start a process that waits, from $ROOT, and git worktree lock --reason "claude session <worktree> (pid P start T)", T being field 22 of /proc/P/stat. owner live: that pid and T. reused: that pid and T+1. dead: the pid of a process that already exited, and T 1
ops.hold: {worktree, exe?}: start a process that waits, with its working directory in the worktree. With `exe`, copy the system's `sleep` program to that path inside the worktree and start the copy from $ROOT instead
ops.transcript: {worktree, at}: write session.jsonl, aged `at`, into $ROOT/claude-projects/<the worktree's transcript folder name>
ops.remote: {name?, push}: create a bare repository $ROOT/<name>.git (name defaulting to origin), add it as remote <name>, push the listed branches, fetch
ops.git: {args, in?, at?}: run git with `args`, $ROOT replaced, inside the checkout `in`
ops.link: {path, target, in?}: create a symbolic link at `path` inside the checkout `in`, pointing at `target` with $ROOT replaced
ops.chmod: {path, mode, in?}: chmod `path` inside the checkout `in` to octal `mode`. Cleanup restores every mode before it deletes $ROOT
ops.use: {fixture}: run the named fixture's steps here
ops.config: {values?, remove?}: merge `values` over the case file's `config`, section by section, and rewrite $ROOT/repo/.agents/harness.toml, or delete that file when `remove` is true
